transcript.text: Now I have the schema. Let me query the count of completed orders by customers in the West region.

args.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND c.region = 'West'
